command:
set -euo pipefail
COMMIT=ed3733fa5a4b8ec399a4c5209e982d9dd9a44c2c
REPO=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
OUT=$VIS/.go_evidence/depthwarp_blind_perceptual_remapfix_gpt56sol_20260912
mkdir -p "$VIS/.go_evidence"
H1=$(sha256sum "$VIS/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
H2=$(sha256sum "$VIS/buehne_daemon.py" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ -f "$VIS/filmlook.js" ]; then H3=$(sha256sum "$VIS/filmlook.js" | awk '{print $1}'); else H3=MISSING; fi
PID1=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo SOURCE_COMMIT=$COMMIT
echo PRE_BUEHNE=$H1
echo PRE_DAEMON=$H2
echo PRE_FILMLOOK=$H3
echo PRE_PRODUCTION_PID=$PID1
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin "$COMMIT"
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-depthwarp-remapfix.XXXXXX)
cleanup(){ git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$TMP/src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$TMP/src" "$COMMIT" >/dev/null
python3 -m py_compile "$TMP/src/research_entity/avatar/tools/depthwarp_display_space_gate.py" "$TMP/src/research_entity/avatar/tools/depthwarp_blind_perceptual_gate.py"
echo PY_COMPILE_PASS
rm -rf "$OUT"
cd "$TMP/src/research_entity/avatar/tools"
python3 depthwarp_blind_perceptual_gate.py --visual-root "$VIS" --out "$OUT"
echo '=== OBJECTIVE SUMMARY ==='
python3 - "$OUT/objective_report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
rows=x['rows']
print(json.dumps({'schema':x['schema'],'candidate_cases':x['candidate_cases'],'eligible_cases':x['eligible_cases'],'credit':x['credit'],'amp_summary':{str(a):{'n':sum(r['amp']==a for r in rows),'eligible':sum(r['amp']==a and r['objective_eligible'] for r in rows),'max_eye_shift':max(r['warp_eye_shift_px'] for r in rows if r['amp']==a),'min_lap_ratio':min(r['warp_lap_ratio'] for r in rows if r['amp']==a),'max_brightness_share':max(r['warp_brightness_share_of_rgb_mae'] for r in rows if r['amp']==a)} for a in sorted(set(r['amp'] for r in rows))}},sort_keys=True))
PY
echo '=== ARTIFACT HASHES ==='
sha256sum "$OUT/blind_manifest.json" "$OUT/answer_key.json" "$OUT/objective_report.json" "$OUT/blind_scores.csv"
H1B=$(sha256sum "$VIS/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
H2B=$(sha256sum "$VIS/buehne_daemon.py" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ -f "$VIS/filmlook.js" ]; then H3B=$(sha256sum "$VIS/filmlook.js" | awk '{print $1}'); else H3B=MISSING; fi
PID2=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo POST_BUEHNE=$H1B
echo POST_DAEMON=$H2B
echo POST_FILMLOOK=$H3B
echo POST_PRODUCTION_PID=$PID2
test "$H1" = "$H1B"
test "$H2" = "$H2B"
test "$H3" = "$H3B"
test "$PID1" = "$PID2"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet frankenstein-buehne.service
echo LIVE_INVARIANCE_PASS
